page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Theme, locale, accessibility preferences, the trigger-evaluation schedule, and the Money Ledger connection state.

priorities.statement: Preferences that change what the operator sees
The evaluation schedule, because it decides how quickly a fired trigger surfaces
Connection state for the actuals source

states.description: The surface at rest with data present — the state a journey step assumes when it names none.
Nothing in flight; the surface is at rest and its controls are usable.
A user-triggered operation is in flight and its outcome is not yet known.
An operation completed; the result is announced, not merely rendered.
First read of the surface's data; layout is reserved so nothing shifts on arrival.
A write is in flight; the affected control is disabled and says why.
A background read is refreshing data the user is already looking at.
A user-requested re-read of data already on screen.
The query succeeded and there is genuinely nothing — distinct from not-yet-loaded.
Some contributing source could not be read; what is missing is named.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown.
Input was rejected before submission; the offending field is identified.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated.
An automatic retry is in progress; attempt count and next attempt are visible.
The caller's role does not permit this; what role would is stated.
The client cannot reach the API; queued or read-only behavior is explained.
The Money Ledger reads are reachable; the connection states when each was last read successfully.
One or both Money Ledger reads are unreachable. The board still ranks its other sources; this surface states which read is down, why, and how old the last good reading is.
Scheduled trigger evaluation is paused. Nothing can reach trigger-met while this holds, which the surface states rather than leaving the operator to infer it from an idle board.

elements.name: Evaluation schedule
elements.description: How often declared triggers are evaluated. This interval is the upper bound on how long a fired condition stays invisible.
States that scheduled evaluation is paused and that no node can reach trigger-met until it resumes.

elements.name: Money Ledger
elements.description: Per-read connection state for the actuals and posture reads, each with the age of its last successful reading.
Why a Money Ledger read is unavailable, stated specifically enough to act on rather than as a generic failure.

elements.name: Language
elements.description: Locale switching. Settings owns this control; it is a durable seam of the generated shell, not page content.

claims.statement: When scheduled evaluation is paused, the page says so and says that nothing can reach trigger-met until it resumes.
claims.rationale: A paused scheduler and a portfolio with nothing to report produce an identical board. This is the one place the difference can be stated, and OT-P0-004 exists precisely because nothing previously evaluated a trigger.

claims.statement: The actuals read and the posture read report their own connection state and their own last-good age.
claims.rationale: INT-005. The two reads degrade independently, so a single combined indicator would report a healthy read as broken or hide a broken one behind a healthy one. The live UI and outage rehearsal prove the per-read reason; the current route-only capture provider cannot stop Money Ledger between captures to produce the disconnected fixture.

claims.statement: A reachable Money Ledger is perceivably different from an unreachable one, without relying on colour.
claims.rationale: DESIGN.md binding adaptation for this scenario: status is never colour-only. This is the status whose misreading turns an unavailable ledger into an apparent zero. The live UI reads BoardResponse availability and names the reason; the current route-only capture provider cannot stop Money Ledger between the two captures.

claims.statement: The evaluation schedule and the ledger connection read before appearance preferences.
claims.rationale: Priorities 2 and 3. Both settings change what the board can tell the operator; theme does not. Direction-aware so the order survives RTL.

claims.statement: The locale control is present on this page.
claims.rationale: Settings ownership of locale switching is a durable seam of the generated shell listed in START-HERE, not illustrative page content. Asserting it here stops a redesign from quietly relocating it.
